name: CM Reddy Inaugurates 26 New Andhra Pradesh Districts
snippet: Apr 4, 2022 — Andhra Pradesh on Monday, 4 April , got 13 new districts , taking the total to 26 , following a major re-organisation of its 13 existing districts .
